blocks.text: Genesis 21 records Sarah’s son Isaac being born at the appointed time and Abraham circumcising him. Sarah’s laughter becomes the occasion for rejoicing, while Hagar and Ishmael are sent away after Sarah sees Ishmael mocking. God hears the boy, provides a well, and preserves them in the wilderness. The chapter closes with Abimelech’s covenant with Abraham at Beersheba and Abraham calling on Jehovah there.
